Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2607.27189v2. Synthetic accounting world/rubric metrics and human-clarification/private-task limitations establish task/evaluation construction. Scored/private/public inventories and distinct metrics remain unresolved/qualified, not reconciled by work admission. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

World/task difficulty was selected using low scores from three model families; clarification/human-in-the-loop tasks were excluded. The scope omits tax, audit, consolidation, multi-entity/multi-currency work and external reporting. Judge agreement is a calibration/selection-sample result with residual error, not independent proof of general benchmark accuracy.

Permanent record ID: repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2607.27189.limitation

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • The v2 paper reports 160 private tasks in ten synthetic company worlds and a separate ten-task public dev world. U.S. GAAP close-cycle tasks omit tax, audit, consolidation, multi-entity/multi-currency work and external reporting.
  • Forty-two accounting experts specify/review worlds and author/solve tasks/rubrics; most world files are synthetically populated under expert review. Independent experts re-solve twenty tasks as a QC check.
  • DeepSeek-v4-Flash with a GEPA-optimized prompt grades final answers against binary outcome-based criteria. Judge selection/calibration uses 1,687 majority-vote labels from 120 trajectories of three solvers and three human raters; 97.1% agreement is that sample result, not an independently held-out accuracy guarantee.
  • Eight runs are planned per task. Mean Criteria@3 uses three runs selected lexicographically by task ID; Pass@8 is any complete success and Pass^8 requires all eight. Model-caused failures are zero; infrastructure failures are excluded, leaving 156-160 tasks per paired comparison.
  • Difficulty selection retains hard worlds under three frontier filtering models, and clarification/human-in-the-loop tasks are excluded.
  • The authors report a self-preference stress test with the judge also solving the benchmark and interpret its 37.1% middle/lower score as no material self-preference. That limited author test does not independently rule out judge bias.
  • This repair uses the v2 paper count only. A prior reference to a separate 100-task leaderboard/card conflict is not reasserted: those distinct artifacts were not read or reconciled here. No private corpus, score reproduction, independent bias audit or source-contribution inference is claimed.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The pinned v2 paper describes 160 private tasks across ten synthetic company worlds and a separate 10-task public dev world. Experts author/solve tasks and unweighted binary rubrics, with synthetic world-file population under expert review. The main metric averages rubric criteria met over three selected runs per task; model executions number eight per task before infrastructure exclusions.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

For the pinned nine-model Loop-harness snapshot, the paper reports a highest Mean Criteria@3 of 56.4%, while no model exceeds 2.6% Pass^8. Mean criterion completion and all-eight-attempt complete-task reliability are different metrics and do not measure a fraction of accounting jobs automated.
